title: Practice 3: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (провести / проводить) детство в Пакистане.
exercises.why: Проводить — провести — to lead through, to spend (time), to lay (a road). Note the expression: "проводить время" — to spend the time. *Как вы проводите время? Я хорошо провёл время. Мы провели в Европе два месяца. В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.* **пройти́** — **проходи́ть** — to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by. **прое́хать** — **проезжа́ть** — to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by; to drive past/along/across. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I spent my childhood in Pakistan.
exercises.context: Проводить — провести — to lead through, to spend (time), to lay (a road).

exercises.q: Самолет ___ (пролететь / пролетать) над Фудзиямой.
exercises.why: **пролете́ть** — **пролета́ть** — to fly (by, past, through), to fly (over); to overfly, to overshoot. **пробежа́ть** — **пробега́ть** — to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time. **проплы́ть** — **проплыва́ть** — to swim by, to float by, to sail by; to swim (a certain distance or time), to sail (a certain distance or time). **пронести́** — **проноси́ть** — to carry (by, past, through), to smuggle, to sneak; (impersonal, colloquial). — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The plane flew over Mt. Fuji.
exercises.context: пролете́ть** — **пролета́ть — to fly (by, past, through), to fly (over); to overfly, to overshoot.
